title: Decide Node 24 support path for native SQLite dependency
description:
Make the Node 22 vs Node 24 support decision explicit, especially around the native SQLite dependency.

This bead should produce a clear decision and align docs, engines, and CI comments. It should not opportunistically upgrade the whole dependency tree.

## Context
Observed gap:
- Node 22 appears to be the supported baseline.
- Existing engine ranges / CI comments imply Node 24 support is blocked on or coupled to better-sqlite3 version/support decisions.
- Without an explicit bead, agents may repeatedly rediscover this and make inconsistent changes.

Parallel-safety:
- Mostly docs/package/CI decision work.
- Avoid importer parser files.
- Avoid broad source-layout changes covered by loreweaver-0jq.16.
design:
Suggested files to inspect/update:
- README.md
- package.json
- packages/*/package.json
- .github/workflows/ci.yml
- AGENTS.md
- package-lock.json only if a deliberate dependency update is chosen

Decision options:
1. Stay on Node 22 for now:
   - Keep engines pinned to Node 22-compatible range.
   - Document why Node 24 is deferred.
   - Ensure CI comments match.
2. Move to Node 24 support:
   - Update better-sqlite3 if needed.
   - Update engines and CI matrix.
   - Verify native install/build expectations in CI.
   - Keep lockfile churn focused and justified.

Implementation guidance:
- Prefer documenting the decision in a small ADR or README/AGENTS note if no ADR pattern exists.
- Do not mix this with unrelated dependency upgrades.
acceptance_criteria:
- There is a clear recorded decision: Node 22 remains the baseline, or Node 24 is supported.
- README, engines, CI, and AGENTS guidance agree.
- Any better-sqlite3 change is intentional and explained.
- CI passes.
- No importer parser files are modified.
